blocks.content: A skeleton loader is a placeholder that mimics the shape of the real content. Instead of a spinner or a text message, the user sees grey blocks that look like the real layout.
It reduces perceived loading time because the page structure is already visible.
Can we apply this on our Journal app? Absolutely!
After all, our app has a consistent layout with a title and a couple of text lines, so one skeleton component covers every page.
